note: One 128x128 oval portrait (BLP2 DXT5 with an elliptic alpha) per minion card, made by tools/art/minion_portraits.py into art/out/Minions/<id>.blp; deploy-addon.ps1 copies them and lists the ids in HS_MinionTextures (CardTextures.lua of the client copy). The texture fills the ring's 'oval' anchor (board_textures.manifest.json, minion_oval).
